items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jo Jones was sort of a mentor. He was psychic, that’s what Jimmy says.

ctx.x: So you only played with him for about eight months. How about Jo Jones?
Jo Jones was sort of a mentor. He was psychic, that’s what Jimmy says. He liked to talk rough to you. “Dancers on the whoozits, whoozits on the whatsits.” He threw a stick at me, you got that?

items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I did a little house there with Dorothy Donegan and Joe Bushkin and Tyree Glenn.

ctx.x: I remember we stayed in the Embers there for a while with Joe Bushkin.

You know you went up and down the Street for one year, one block one year. I did a little house there with Dorothy Donegan and Joe Bushkin and Tyree Glenn. Of course, I had the trio there with Hank Jones, my original trio with Hank Jones, Tommy Potter -
